text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ugh... W-Why did I do that...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Uuuuugh... That wasn't even a spot I 
should've stumbled over...!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(E-Everyone definitely thought I was 
weird... Ugh... I want to erase it... I 
want to disappear...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Troubled by her mistakes during the day, 
Cheval Grand tossed and turned, unable to 
sleep...
